name: start (rotating file sink)

test_list.description: Files never exceed rotate_bytes and several files appear.
After many rotations exactly keep_files files remain (2 and 3).
With generous retention every line appears once, in order, across the rotated files.
Seeded fake secrets never reach the file.
JSON mode writes one {ts,level,target,fields} object per line.
A log directory that cannot be created is LogError::SinkInit, not a panic.
Stress: every rotation fails; producers keep running, sink errors are counted and the last error is readable.
8 producers against a 16-slot queue: accepted + dropped == emitted and every accepted record reaches the file; worst call latency is printed.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Directory, rotation size and file count.

output_description: Drain thread writes through spdlog-rs RotatingFileSink with bounded retry.
